sentences.zh: 老师们发现她安静且守规矩，她以害羞的性格和良好的礼貌迷倒了她遇到的每一个人。

sentences.en: At around 4.45pm, the mother and daughter successfully completed their mission to find material for Shan's skirt.
sentences.zh: 大约下午4点45分，这对母女成功完成了寻找制作山姆裙子布料的任务。

sentences.en: Before embarking on the one-kilometre walk back to their house in Noosa's suburbs, Linda decided to stop into the bakery to buy a loaf of bread for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 在踏上返回努萨住宅区家中那一公里的步行路程之前，琳达决定顺便去面包店买一条周末吃的主食面包。

sentences.en: Sian told her mother that she would get a head start on her bike as she was eager to change out of her school uniform, a blue and white striped summer dress.
sentences.zh: 西安告诉母亲她要骑自行车先走一步，因为她急着换掉她的校服——一条蓝白相间的夏季条纹连衣裙。

sentences.en: Linda Kingy didn't hesitate in agreeing to let her daughter make the short bike ride home.
sentences.zh: 琳达·金吉毫不犹豫地同意让女儿骑短途自行车回家。

sentences.en: Noosa in the 80s was like a country town on the beach, safe and secure, where no one was a stranger.
sentences.zh: 80年代的努萨就像海滩上的一个乡村小镇，安全稳妥，没有人是陌生人。

sentences.en: Parents didn't think twice about letting their children walk or ride their bikes till and from school, or to visit friends and play in the park until it was time to come home
sentences.zh: 父母让孩子步行或骑自行车上学放学，或者去拜访朋友并在公园里玩耍，直到晚饭时间回家，

sentences.en: for dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们对此毫不犹豫。

sentences.en: After she purchased the bread, Linda would take a shortcut home along the sandy walking path.
sentences.zh: 买完面包后，琳达将沿着沙质步行小路走捷径回家。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Sian would ride along the bike track through nearby Pinaroo Park.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，西安将骑着自行车穿过附近的皮纳鲁公园。

sentences.en: The bike track weaved from behind the brightly lit busy shopping centre through picturesque, quiet parklands of the reserve.
sentences.zh: 自行车道从明亮繁忙的购物中心后面蜿蜒穿过保护区风景优美、安静的公园。

sentences.en: It was a kilometre-long ride Sian had taken a hundred times before.
sentences.zh: 这是一段长达一公里的骑行，西安以前已经走过上百次了。

sentences.en: Despite the extra distance, with the head start, Sian would easily beat her mother home.
sentences.zh: 尽管路程多了一些，但由于提前出发，西安很容易就能比母亲先到家。

sentences.en: The 12-year-old slung her olive green school bag over her shoulders, climbed onto her bike, and set off.
sentences.zh: 这名12岁的女孩将橄榄绿色书包背在肩上，骑上自行车出发了。

sentences.en: Linda selected a loaf from the hot bread display, a transaction which only took a couple of minutes.
sentences.zh: 琳达从热面包陈列柜里挑选了一条面包，这个交易只花了短短几分钟。

sentences.en: She then started the walk to the Kingy family homestead via the sandy track.
sentences.zh: 然后她开始经由沙质小路步行前往金吉一家的宅基。

sentences.en: When Linda arrived home a short time later, Sian and her bike were nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 不久后当琳达回到家时，不见西安和她自行车的踪影。

sentences.en: Linda didn't think much of it, assuming her daughter had run into some friends on the way home and stopped to chat about school or the forthcoming party.
sentences.zh: 琳达并没有多想，以为女儿在回家的路上遇到了几个朋友，停下来聊了聊学校或即将到来的派对。

sentences.en: However, when dusk approached and Sian still hadn't returned home, Linda became increasingly concerned.
sentences.zh: 然而，当夜幕降临而西安仍未回家时，琳达越来越担心了。

sentences.en: Her daughter was not prone to disobedience or thoughtlessness, and it was very out of character for her to stay out so much later than she knew she was allowed to.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿不是一个会违抗命令或考虑不周的孩子，在明知被允许的时间之外滞留这么久非常不符合她的性格。

sentences.en: Linda picked up the phone and began making calls to all of Sian's friends, trying to locate her, but each response confirmed that none of them had seen Sian since they left
sentences.zh: 琳达拿起电话开始给西安的所有朋友打电话，试图找到她，但每一个回答都证实自从放学

sentences.en: school for the day.
sentences.zh: 离开后就没有人见过西安。

sentences.en: Sian's father, Barry Kingy, arrived home a little after 8pm and was immediately alerted to the fact that Linda hadn't seen their daughter since the pair had parted ways at Noosa
sentences.zh: 西安的父亲巴里·金吉在晚上8点刚过回到家，立刻得知了琳达自下午4点45分左右在努萨

sentences.en: Junction around 4.45pm.
sentences.zh: 章克申分头后就一直没见着女儿的情况。

sentences.en: The couple immediately set off to Pinaroo Park to retrace the route
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇立即动身前往皮纳鲁公园，原路返回

sentences.en: Sian would have taken, hoping to find her along the way.
sentences.zh: 西安会走路线，希望能一路上找到她。

sentences.en: When the concerned parents arrived at the bike track, it only took them a few minutes to find Sian's yellow bike discarded on the side
sentences.zh: 当这对焦虑的父母到达自行车道时，他们只花了几分钟就在小路边

sentences.en: of the path, but there was no sign of their daughter.
sentences.zh: 找到了被丢弃的西安的黄色自行车，但不见他们女儿的踪影。

sentences.en: Knowing there was no way Sian would have willingly abandoned her beloved bike, Linda and Barry placed the bicycle into the trailer of
sentences.zh: 深知西安绝不可能自愿抛弃她心爱的自行车，琳达和巴里把自行车放进

sentences.en: Barry's ute and headed straight to the police station.
sentences.zh: 巴里多用途车的拖车里，径直朝警察局驶去。

sentences.en: The couple walked into the Noosa police station at 8.40pm and presented their daughter's photograph to Detective Sergeant Bob Atkinson.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇于晚上8点40分走进努萨警察局，将他们女儿的照片出示给警长鲍勃·阿特金森。

sentences.en: Noosa was a town of less than 15,000 residents and Sergeant Atkinson knew 12-year-old Sian
sentences.zh: 努萨是一个居民不到1.5万人的小镇，阿特金森警长一眼就认出了12岁的西安

sentences.en: Kingy by sight as she played in the same netball league as his own daughter.
sentences.zh: ·金吉，因为她和他的女儿在同一个英式篮网球联盟打球。

sentences.en: The Kingys assured Atkinson it would be completely out of character for Sian to run away or not come home by nightfall.
sentences.zh: 金吉夫妇向阿特金森保证，西安离家出走或在夜幕降临前不回家是完全不符合她的性格的。

sentences.en: Atkinson accompanied the Kingies back to Pinaroo Park to check whether Sian had perhaps injured herself or fallen unconscious nearby.
sentences.zh: 阿特金森陪同金吉夫妇返回皮纳鲁公园，查看西安是否可能在附近受伤或晕倒。

sentences.en: But Sian wasn't there, and neither were her belongings.
sentences.zh: 但西安不在那里，她的随身物品也不翼而飞。

sentences.en: Detective Sergeant Atkinson was highly concerned, but he knew theirs was a safe and close-knit community, so he tried to remain positive.
sentences.zh: 警长阿特金森非常担心，但他知道他们的社区是一个安全且紧密团结的社区，所以他尽量保持乐观。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: I would have thought that 5.30 in the afternoon in Noosa in summer would have been one of the safest places in Australia for a kiddie to be.
sentences.zh: 我认为夏天下午5点30分的努萨本应是全澳大利亚对小孩而言最安全的地方之一。

sentences.en: Upon returning to the station, Atkinson rang the night desk of the local newspaper, Sunshine Coast Daily.
sentences.zh: 回到警局后，阿特金森给当地报纸《阳光海岸每日新闻》的夜间值班台打了电话。

sentences.en: It was past the deadline for print submissions, but the newspaper made an exception and agreed to run the photograph of Sian.
sentences.zh: 当时已经过了印刷截稿时间，但该报破例同意刊登西安的照片，

sentences.en: along with the details of her disappearance for the Saturday morning edition of the paper.
sentences.zh: 连同她失踪的详细信息一起登在周六早晨的报纸上。

sentences.en: Shan Kingy was officially declared a missing person.
sentences.zh: 西安·金吉被正式宣布为失踪人口。

sentences.en: Barry and Linda Kingy endured a sleepless night without their daughter.
sentences.zh: 巴里和琳达·金吉在没有女儿的情况下熬过了一个不眠之夜。

sentences.en: They waited anxiously for daybreak when they could resume their inquiries around town, aided by the news release that would appear in the morning's paper.
sentences.zh: 他们焦急地等待天亮，以便在早报上新闻报道的帮助下恢复在镇上的打听。

sentences.en: Although no information about Shan's whereabouts came in overnight, by the time the
sentences.zh: 尽管关于西安下落的信息在夜间没有传进来，但当

sentences.en: sun came up, every available police officer in the Noosa district was assigned to be on the lookout for Shan Kingie.
sentences.zh: 太阳升起时，努萨地区所有可用的警员都被指派去搜寻西安·金吉。

sentences.en: As news of Shan Kingie's disappearance spread throughout the local community, leads started trickling in.
sentences.zh: 随着西安·金吉失踪的消息在当地社区传开，线索开始断断续续地涌现。

sentences.en: Some witnesses reported seeing Shan in Pinaroo Park on the day of her disappearance, but had not noted her as being in danger.
sentences.zh: 一些目击者报告说在西安失踪当天在皮纳鲁公园见过她，但没有注意到她处于危险之中。

sentences.en: A couple of people also reported having seen cars in a parking bay at the edge of the reserve
sentences.zh: 还有几个人报告说在西安失踪前后看到保护区边缘的停车位里停着车，

sentences.en: around the time Sian went missing, one of which was described as a white, dust-covered station wagon.
sentences.zh: 其中一辆被描述为一辆白色的、落满灰尘的旅行车。

sentences.en: Members of the community reported every single detail they thought may help, no matter how minor.
sentences.zh: 社区成员们把他们认为可能有所帮助的每一个细微细节都报告了上来，无论多么微不足道。

sentences.en: Every flasher, loiterer, pickpocket, drug dealer, and suspicious-looking stranger were hauled into the police station for questioning.
sentences.zh: 每一个闪光灯前晃荡的人、闲逛者、扒手、毒贩和形迹可疑的陌生人都被带到了警察局接受盘问。

sentences.en: However, nothing discussed led to
sentences.zh: 然而，讨论的没有一条线索能指向

sentences.en: Sian's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 西安的下落。

sentences.en: The people of Noosa and the surrounding Sunshine Coast district banded together like they never had before, united in the quest to find young Sian Kingy, as fears for her
sentences.zh: 努萨以及周边阳光海岸地区的居民前所未有地团结在一起，大家为了寻找年轻的西安·金吉而齐心协力，因为人们对她的

sentences.en: safety grew.
sentences.zh: 安全的担忧日益加剧。

sentences.en: The community gave an outpouring of support to the girls' concerned parents, while Detective Sergeant Atkinson took the Kingy family under his wing,
sentences.zh: 社区向女孩们焦虑的父母倾注了大量支持，而警长阿特金森则将金吉一家护在羽翼之下，

sentences.en: personally ensuring they were kept in the loop every step of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 亲自确保他们在调查的每一步都随时了解进展。

sentences.en: On Sunday, November 29, Sian's friends celebrated the birthday of a classmate at Noosa National Park.
sentences.zh: 11月29日星期日，西安的朋友们在努萨国家公园庆祝了一位同班同学的生日。

sentences.en: Sian had been looking forward to the party all week, the fabric she had carefully selected for her party skirt sitting untouched at home.
sentences.zh: 西安整个星期都在期盼着这个派对，她为派对裙子精心挑选的面料此时还静静地躺在家里的角落里。

sentences.en: Sian had been missing for two days, and hope remained high that the 12-year-old would suddenly reappear and attend the party.
sentences.zh: 西安已经失踪两天了，大家仍然抱有很高的希望，期待这个12岁的女孩会突然出现并参加派对。

sentences.en: But that hope was soon shattered when Sian was a no-show.
sentences.zh: 但随着西安的缺席，这份希望很快破灭了。

sentences.en: With no sign of Sian emerging, the Noosa Police Department put in a call to the Brisbane Homicide Squad and requested for
sentences.zh: 在没有任何西安出现的迹象的情况下，努萨警察局向布里斯班凶杀案调查组打了电话，请求

sentences.en: as many detectives as they could spare to make the 140km trip up the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 尽可能多调配一些侦探，北上140公里支援海岸。

sentences.en: Although there was no evidence to suggest Sian had been killed, a dozen homicide detectives converged on the Noosa Township to offer their assistance in the search.
sentences.zh: 尽管没有证据表明西安遇害，但十几名凶杀案侦探依然汇聚到努萨镇，协助搜寻工作。

sentences.en: A command centre was set up in Noosa's criminal investigation branch and it was manned around the clock.
sentences.zh: 一个指挥中心在努萨刑事调查分局设立，并有专人进行全天候值守。

sentences.en: In an attempt to jog memories, a mannequin dressed in Sian's blue and white striped school dress was put on display in Pinaroo Park, near the location she was last seen.
sentences.zh: 为了唤醒人们的记忆，一个穿着西安蓝白相间校服裙的假人被摆放在皮纳鲁公园展出，这里是她最后被目击的地方。

sentences.en: By Sunday evening,
sentences.zh: 到星期天傍晚，

sentences.en: Sian's disappearance was headlining every local news bulletin, resulting in a flood of leads to
sentences.zh: 西安的失踪成了各大地方新闻播报的头条，导致大量线索涌向了

sentences.en: Noosa Police.
sentences.zh: 努萨警方。

sentences.en: Many of these reports led nowhere.
sentences.zh: 这些报告大多无果而终。

sentences.en: They were either observations or incidents unrelated to Shan's disappearance, the product of overactive imaginations, or created purely for attention.
sentences.zh: 它们要么是与西安失踪无关的观察或事件，是过度想象的产物，要么纯粹是为了吸引眼球而捏造的。

sentences.en: Unsubstantiated sightings were abundant, placing Shan near the local bowls club, tennis courts, surf club, and even hitchhiking northbound.
sentences.zh: 未经证实的目击报告层出不穷，声称在当地地掷球俱乐部、网球场、冲浪俱乐部甚至是在向北搭便车的地方看到了西安。

sentences.en: Investigations were stifled from clairvoyants who insisted on having their visions taken seriously, and mentally unwell people who
sentences.zh: 调查受到了那些坚称要认真对待其所谓“天眼通”愿景的灵媒的阻挠，还有精神状况不佳的人

sentences.en: confessed to the crime, but could provide no further information than what was in the papers.
sentences.zh: 对罪行供认不讳，但却提供不出任何报纸上没有的新信息。

sentences.en: A total of 700 leads were investigated, most taking the investigation nowhere.
sentences.zh: 警方总共调查了700条线索，其中大部分都让调查陷入了死胡同。

sentences.en: However, there was one detail that kept coming up in various reports.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一个细节在各种报告中反复出现。

sentences.en: Witness sightings of a white station wagon with out-of-state licence plates in the vicinity of Pinaroo Park at the time Shan vanished.
sentences.zh: 目击者称，在西安失踪期间，皮纳鲁公园附近出现了一辆挂着外州车牌的白色旅行车。

sentences.en: The description of this station wagon differed in each statement.
sentences.zh: 每份证词对这辆旅行车的描述各不相同。

sentences.en: Some witnesses claimed the vehicle had curtains, yet others were certain they could see inside, and it may or may not have had mag wheels or roof racks.
sentences.zh: 一些目击者称车上有窗帘，而另一些人则确信能看清车内，而且它可能装有也可能没装铝合金轮毂或行李架。

sentences.en: But despite these conflicting specifics, the vehicle was consistently described as a dusty, white station wagon, likely a Holden Kingswood model that was several years old.
sentences.zh: 但尽管这些具体细节相互冲突，这辆车被一致描述为一辆满是灰尘的白色旅行车，很可能是车龄好几年的霍顿·金斯伍德车型。

sentences.en: Witnesses who had caught a glimpse of the vehicle's occupants provided a description of a man with a surfy-like appearance who was in the company of a plump woman.
sentences.zh: 曾瞥见车内人员的目击者描述说，车上有一个长相带有冲浪风格的男子，陪伴着一个丰满的女人。

sentences.en: None had seen a little girl.
sentences.zh: 没有人看到一个小女孩。

sentences.en: Police urged everyone in the Sunshine
sentences.zh: 警方敦促阳光

sentences.en: Coast District who had a vehicle that so much as vaguely matched the witness descriptions of
sentences.zh: 海岸地区所有拥有哪怕有一点点符合目击者描述特征的车辆的车主——

sentences.en: the white station wagon to come forward so their car could be eliminated from the investigation.
sentences.zh: 也就是那辆白色旅行车——主动站出来，以便将他们的车从调查中排除。

sentences.en: Every white station wagon that ventured onto Queensland roads was pulled over, many several times a day.
sentences.zh: 每一辆驶上昆士兰道路的白色旅行车都被拦了下来，许多车一天被拦了好几次。

sentences.en: The drivers aggressively questioned about their whereabouts the previous
sentences.zh: 司机们遭到严厉盘问，以查明他们在前一个

sentences.en: Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 周五傍晚的行踪。

sentences.en: To save time, police issued drivers who were cleared of any suspicion with a card that they could flash should they be pulled over again as proof that they had been given the all
sentences.zh: 为了节省时间，警方为洗脱嫌疑的司机发放了一张卡片，如果再次被拦截，他们可以出示这张卡片，作为已经获得全面

sentences.en: clear.
sentences.zh: 排查通过的证明。

sentences.en: The search for the vehicle of interest in the Sian Kingy missing person investigation was no small feat.
sentences.zh: 在西安·金吉失踪案中寻找这辆受关注的车辆绝非易事。

sentences.en: Holden Kingswood station wagons were an exceedingly common type of car, with 17,000 of them registered in Queensland alone, 10,000 of which were white.
sentences.zh: 霍顿·金斯伍德旅行车是一种极其常见的车型，仅在昆士兰州就有17,000辆登记在册，其中10,000辆是白色的。

sentences.en: Having worked the night before and subsequently slept for most of the following day,
sentences.zh: 由于前一天晚上了夜班，并在接下来的大半天里一直在睡觉，

sentences.en: 31-year-old bartender Elizabeth Young had missed the escalating drama regarding the disappearance of Sian Kingy.
sentences.zh: 31岁的调酒师伊丽莎白·杨错失了关于西安·金吉失踪案不断升级的戏剧性进展。

sentences.en: When she was finally made aware of the news, Elizabeth couldn't believe what she was hearing.
sentences.zh: 当她终于得知这一消息时，伊丽莎白简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

sentences.en: Elizabeth knew Linda Kingy as the two had worked together at the Mango Tree
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白认识琳达·金吉，因为两人几年前曾在芒果树

sentences.en: Cafe a few years earlier.
sentences.zh: 咖啡馆一起工作过。

sentences.en: Sian and her younger brother used to visit the cafe after school, enjoying milkshakes while they waited for their mother to finish her shift.
sentences.zh: 西安和她年幼的弟弟过去常常放学后来咖啡馆，一边喝着奶昔，一边等他们的母亲下班。

sentences.en: When police appealed for information regarding a dusty white station wagon,
sentences.zh: 当警方呼吁提供有关一辆积满灰尘的白色旅行车的线索时，

sentences.en: Elizabeth's mind immediately returned to Castaway's Beach on the afternoon of Friday
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白的脑海里立刻浮现出11月27日星期五

sentences.en: November 27, the day Sian vanished.
sentences.zh: 下午，也就是西安失踪那天，她在卡斯特威海滩的场景。

sentences.en: Elizabeth and her companion Bill Wallace witnessed a dishevelled man behaving suspiciously along the shoreline before driving off from the beach car
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白和她的同伴比尔·华莱士目睹了一个衣衫褴褛的男子在海岸线附近形迹可疑，随后从海滩停车

sentences.en: park in a dusty white station wagon at around 3pm.

sentences.zh: 清爽的山间空气中依然残留着这股气味，于是尼尔顺着气味寻找，离开小路，深入森林一小段距离，朝卡斯特威溪的方向走去。

sentences.zh: 约翰·斯泰尔警员（Constable John Stare）已经结束了值班，正准备出门，这时他接到警报称，努萨警方正在搜寻一辆挂着维多利亚州车牌的白色霍顿金斯伍德（Holden Kingswood）旅行车。

sentences.zh: 在洛伍德这样一个小乡村镇，看到一辆外州牌照的车已经足够不寻常，以至于斯泰尔记下了车牌的前半部分，

sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，即12月10日星期四，

sentences.zh: 这段对话勾起了科林的记忆。

sentences.zh: 他最近在爬电话杆工作时，曾看到一辆挂着维多利亚州车牌的白色霍顿金斯伍德旅行车停在洛伍德一处住宅的院子里。

sentences.zh: 他对这辆车特别注意，因为他当时正考虑买一款类似的车型，并记得它确切停在门前的是哪栋房子。

sentences.en: The next morning, Colin Harm led police to an A-frame house on an acre block.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，科林·哈姆带领警察来到一处占地一英亩的A字形房屋。

sentences.zh: 那辆白色旅行车已经不在院子里了，而且看起来家里没有人。

sentences.en: A local real estate agency confirmed that Barry Watts and Valmay Beck's names were on the lease of the Lowood property, and police obtained a search warrant for the house.
sentences.zh: 当地一家房地产机构证实，巴里·沃茨和瓦尔迈·贝克的名字在洛伍德房产的租约上，警察获得了对该房屋的搜查令。

sentences.en: When they entered the residence, no one was inside.
sentences.zh: 当他们进入住宅时，里面空无一人。

sentences.en: Police found empty packets of hair dye in the rubbish bin and evidence indicating that the couple had left in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 警察在垃圾桶里发现了空的染发剂包装，以及表明这对夫妇匆忙离开的迹象。

sentences.en: A rolled-up newspaper on the kitchen floor was dated the previous Friday, December 4.
sentences.zh: 厨房地板上卷起的一份报纸日期是上周五，即12月4日。

sentences.en: Police had missed the fugitives by a week.
sentences.zh: 警察与逃犯擦肩而过，晚了一周。

sentences.zh: 屋里没有发现任何能揭示这对夫妇目前下落的证据。

sentences.zh: 努萨指挥中心，通报他正在监视嫌疑车辆。

sentences.zh: 侦探警长鲍勃·阿特金森，自西安·金吉父母报案失踪那天起就一直负责该案的调查，

sentences.en: Fears of a potential shootout immediately subsided when the couple offered no resistance and were arrested without incident.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇没有进行反抗且被无抵抗逮捕，这立即消除了对可能发生枪战的担忧。

sentences.en: Police brought the pair to the local police station, separated them and launched into interrogations.
sentences.zh: 警方将两人带到当地警察局，将他们分开并展开审讯。

sentences.en: Barry Watts, seasoned career criminal, knew no good could ever come from talking to the police.
sentences.zh: 巴里·沃茨是一名经验丰富的职业罪犯，深知跟警察说话绝没有好事。

sentences.en: He refused to provide his name and shook his head when asked whether the mugshot they had was a picture of him.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝透露自己的姓名，当被问及手头的那张嫌疑人照片是不是他本人时，他摇了摇头。

sentences.en: Watts denied having ever been in Noosa, claiming to have just travelled up to Lowood from Melbourne where the pair had lived for the past 10 years.
sentences.zh: 沃茨否认自己去过努萨，声称自己只是从墨尔本一路北上来到洛伍德，两人在墨尔本已经住了10年。

sentences.en: It was an obvious lie, as investigators were aware
sentences.zh: 这是一个显而易见的谎言，因为调查人员知道

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in a separate interrogation room, Valmay Beck provided police with a story which placed the couple in Noosa on the day of Sian's murder.

sentences.en: Beck claimed the couple spent the day of

sentences.zh: 巴里·沃茨随后开车去了努萨，在那里睡了几个小时，然后才回来接妻子回家去洛伍德。

sentences.en: When the couple were reunited in the police station, they gave nothing away.
sentences.zh: 当这对夫妇在警察局团聚时，他们什么也没有透露。

sentences.en: Valmay Beck sat on Barry Watt's lap and the two smoked cigarettes, kissed, and chatted as if they didn't have a care in the world.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈·贝克坐在巴里·沃茨的腿上，两人抽着烟、接吻、聊天，仿佛他们没有一丝烦恼。

sentences.en: As Beck was led away for further questioning, Watt told his wife to stick by him.
sentences.zh: 当贝克被带走接受进一步审讯时，沃茨告诉他的妻子要坚定地支持他。

sentences.zh: 她答应了。

sentences.en: Valmay Faye Beck was born in 1943 to a family dominated by a cold, unloving matriarch who would offload young Valmé onto any relatives who would take her.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈·费伊·贝克（Valmay Faye Beck）于1943年出生于一个由冷酷、毫无爱心的女家长主导的家庭，她会把年幼的瓦尔迈（Valmé）推卸给任何愿意收留她的亲戚。

sentences.en: Valmé's three brothers ran wild and were not protective of their little sister.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈的三个兄弟无法无天，对小妹妹并不保护。

sentences.en: If no relatives were available to watch over Valmé, she was left in the company of strangers, some of whom subjected her to sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 如果没有亲戚可以照看瓦尔迈，她就会被留给陌生人陪伴，其中一些人对她实施了性虐待。

sentences.en: By the time she was 12 years old, Valmé had been pulled out of school by her mother and sent to work in a clothing factory so she could pay her own way.
sentences.zh: 到她12岁时，瓦尔迈被母亲带出学校，送去服装厂工作，以便她能自食其力。

sentences.en: Three years later, when Valmay was 15, she was registered as a neglected child and committed to the care of the state.
sentences.zh: 三年后，当瓦尔迈15岁时，她被登记为被忽视儿童，并交由国家监管。

sentences.en: Between 1961 and 1972, Valmay was in and out of prison on a variety of offences.
sentences.zh: 在1961年至1972年期间，瓦尔迈因各种罪行多次进出监狱。

sentences.en: She changed her name periodically and drifted between menial jobs.
sentences.zh: 她定期改名，在各种低级工作之间漂泊。

sentences.en: Regarded as uneducated and unlikable, Valmay Beck nevertheless married twice and gave birth to six children from at least two men.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈·贝克被认为受教育程度低且不讨人喜欢，但她还是结过两次婚，并与至少两个人生育了六个孩子。

sentences.en: She harboured little to no maternal instincts.
sentences.zh: 她几乎没有或根本没有母性本能。

sentences.en: Her children were either taken away by authorities and made into wards of the state, or put into the custody of their fathers and raised elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 她的孩子要么被当局带走成为国家受养人，要么被交由他们的父亲抚养长大。

sentences.en: Valmay spent much of her time in seedy bars run by staff who allowed her to keep drinking long after she should have been cut off.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈大部分时间都在肮脏的酒吧里度过，那里的工作人员允许她继续喝酒，远在她本该被拒绝之后。

sentences.en: By 1983, she was a foul-mouthed drunk with children and a grandchild she very rarely saw, living in one of the down-and-out suburbs of Perth, Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 到1983年，她成了一个满口脏话的酒鬼，有着很少能见到的孩子和一个孙辈，住在西澳大利亚州珀斯的贫民窟郊区之一。

sentences.en: It was in one of Perth's dingy pubs that Valmay was introduced to Barry Watts, a man ten years her junior.
sentences.zh: 正是在珀斯的一家昏暗酒吧里，瓦尔迈被介绍认识了比她小十岁的巴里·沃茨。

sentences.en: Barry, an orphan, had an equally troubling childhood and was now making his way as a career criminal.
sentences.zh: 巴里是个孤儿，有着同样令人不安的童年，如今正以职业罪犯的身份谋生。

sentences.en: The two bondered over stories of their time spent in prison.
sentences.zh: 两人因为在监狱度过的时间的故事而结缘。

sentences.en: Valmay told Barry about the time she befriended Catherine Burney, a fellow inmate in a Western Australian prison.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈告诉巴里关于她与凯瑟琳·伯尼（Catherine Burney）结为朋友的事，后者是西澳大利亚州监狱的一名同狱犯人。

sentences.en: Catherine Burney was incarcerated for the abduction, rape, and murders of four women, crime she committed with her husband David, covered in case 31 of case file.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·伯尼因绑架、强奸和谋杀四名女性而入狱，这些罪行是她与丈夫大卫（David）一起犯下的，案件档案第31号有所涵盖。

sentences.en: During their time incarcerated together, Catherine Burney allegedly told Valmay Beck that having sex while murdering a female was the greatest thrill of all.

sentences.zh: 由于沃茨没有做任何招认，控方严重依赖对他与瓦尔迈·

sentences.en: Beck following their arreSt. The recordings were corroborated by Beck herself, who had since divorced her husband and agreed to testify against him.
sentences.zh: 贝克被捕后对话的秘密录音。这些录音得到了贝克本人的证实，她当时已经与丈夫离婚，并同意出庭作证指控他。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Young, the woman who had witnessed Barry Watts behaving suspiciously on Castaway's Beach shortly before he abducted and murdered Sean Kingy, testified at his trial.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·杨是目睹巴里·沃茨在绑架和谋杀肖恩·金吉前不久在卡斯塔韦斯海滩表现可疑的女性，她在他的审判中出庭作证。

sentences.en: She said she wanted to look Watts straight in the eye and have him, quote, go to bed every single night thinking there is a woman out there who put him behind bars.
sentences.zh: 她说她想直视沃茨的眼睛，让他，引用原话，每天晚上上床睡觉时都想着外面有个女人把他关在了铁窗后。

sentences.en: Although Elizabeth provided investigators with the breakthrough needed to identify Sian's killers, she struggled with the guilt of not reporting Watts before he
sentences.zh: 尽管伊丽莎白为调查人员提供了确定西恩凶手所需的突破口，但她一直饱受内疚的折磨，因为她没有在沃茨

sentences.en: had the opportunity to harm Sian.
sentences.zh: 有机会伤害西恩之前举报他。

sentences.en: Quote, my big regret is that I didn't do something on the first day, but it's like trying to prevent a car accident before it happens.
sentences.zh: 引用原话，我最大的遗憾就是第一天没有采取行动，但这就像在车祸发生前试图阻止它一样。

sentences.en: Nothing I did was ever going to bring her back, but I stopped him from doing it to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我做的任何事情都无法让她复活，但我阻止了他对其他人这样做。

sentences.en: Barry White's trial lasted eight days.
sentences.zh: 巴里·怀特的审判持续了八天。

sentences.en: On February 8, 1990, after six hours of deliberations, a jury found him guilty of Sean Kingy's abduction, rape, and murder.
sentences.zh: 1990年2月8日，经过六小时的审议，陪审团裁定他绑架、强奸和谋杀肖恩·金吉罪名成立。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to three years, fifteen years, and of life, respectively.
sentences.zh: 他分别被判处三年、十五年和终身监禁。

sentences.en: Upon sentencing, Queensland Supreme Court Justice Kelly remarked, quote, The vulgar crime shows you to be an evil man void of any sense of morality.
sentences.zh: 宣判时，昆士兰州最高法院法官凯利评论道，引用原话，这起低俗的罪行表明你是一个毫无道德感的邪恶之人。

sentences.en: Justice Kelly told the court the circumstances of Sean Kingy's murder were so abhorrent that Barry Watts' file should be marked, never to be released.
sentences.zh: 凯利法官告诉法庭，肖恩·金吉被谋杀的情节极其令人发指，因此巴里·沃茨的档案上应标注永不得假释。

sentences.en: While he was in prison,
sentences.zh: 在服刑期间，

sentences.en: Barry Watts boasted to other inmates about the murder of not only Sian Kingy but of another young woman as well.
sentences.zh: 巴里·沃茨向其他犯人吹嘘说，自己不仅谋杀了西恩·金吉，还谋杀了另一名年轻女性。

sentences.en: To determine the validity of these claims, an undercover police officer was planted in Barry Watts' cell in an attempt to coax information from the convicted killer.
sentences.zh: 为了查明这些说法的真实性，警方将一名卧底警员安插进巴里·沃茨的牢房，试图套出这名被定罪杀人犯的信息。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, investigators combed through missing person and unsolved murder cases, hoping to find a connection to Barry Watts.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，调查人员仔细搜查了失踪人口和未破谋杀案的卷宗，希望能找到与巴里·沃茨的联系。

sentences.en: One case that stood out to investigators was the disappearance of 31-year-old Queensland mother Helen Mary Feeney.
sentences.zh: 有一个案件引起了调查人员的注意，那就是31岁昆士兰母亲海伦·玛丽·费尼的失踪案。

sentences.en: Helen was a petite woman with light, sandy hair who had vanished at 6.30pm on October 29, 1987, mere weeks before
sentences.zh: 海伦是一位身材娇小、有着浅色沙黄色头发的女性，她于1987年10月29日下午6点30分失踪，就在

sentences.en: Sian Kingy's murder.
sentences.zh: 西恩·金吉被谋杀几周前。

sentences.en: Helen Feeney was studying to be a teacher at a college in North Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 海伦·费尼当时正在布里斯班北部的一所学院学习成为一名教师。

sentences.en: Her white Holden Gemini sedan was found abandoned in the college's parking lot.
sentences.zh: 她的白色霍顿双门轿车被发现遗弃在学院的停车场里。

sentences.en: the driver's side window smashed.
sentences.zh: 驾驶座侧边的车窗被砸碎。

sentences.en: No sign of Helen had since been found and she was presumed murdered.
sentences.zh: 此后再也没有发现海伦的踪迹，她被推定已经遇害。

sentences.en: The timing of Helen's disappearance coincided with the beginning of Barry Watts and Valmay Beck's crime spree.
sentences.zh: 海伦失踪的时间与巴里·沃茨和瓦尔迈·贝克犯罪狂潮的开始时间吻合。

sentences.en: Less than two weeks after Helen vanished, Watts and Beck attempted to abduct three women in Ipswich, located just 40 kilometres away from Helen's college.
sentences.zh: 海伦失踪不到两周后，沃茨和贝克试图在伊普斯维奇绑架三名女性，该地距离海伦就读的学院仅40公里。

sentences.en: Investigators pressed Watts for information about Helen Feeney, saying they wanted to pronounce her dead and locate her remains to provide closure for her family.
sentences.zh: 调查人员向沃茨施压，要求他提供关于海伦·费尼的信息，称他们希望宣布她死亡并找到她的遗骸，以便给她的家人一个交代。

sentences.en: But the convicted killer denied having anything to do with the mother's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 但这名被定罪的杀人犯否认自己与这位母亲的失踪有任何关系。

sentences.en: Once again, Valmay Beck implicated her ex-husband, telling investigators that Watts killed the young mother during a bungled car break-in.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈·贝克再次将矛头指向她的前夫，告诉调查人员沃茨是在一次搞砸了的汽车盗窃中杀害了这位年轻母亲的。

sentences.en: According to Beck, they parked a couple of spaces away from a small white car, and she acted as a lookout for Watts as he broke into the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 据贝克称，他们将车停在距离一辆小白车几个车位远的地方，当沃茨破门盗车时，她在旁边放风。

sentences.en: Beck heard the sound of glass smashing, and shortly thereafter, Watts placed something wrapped in a red doona into the rear of their station wagon.
sentences.zh: 贝克听到玻璃砸碎的声音，不久之后，沃茨将一个用红色羽绒被包裹的东西放进了他们旅行车的后备厢。

sentences.en: Beck claimed she did not see a body, but, quote, vaguely saw what looked like somebody's sandy-coloured hair.
sentences.zh: 贝克声称她没有看到尸体，但是，引用原话，隐约看到了看起来像某人的沙黄色头发的东西。

sentences.en: Beck claimed Watts told her that Helen had disturbed him breaking into the car.
sentences.zh: 贝克声称沃茨告诉她，海伦打扰了他撬车。

sentences.en: and she was now dead.
sentences.zh: 而且她现在已经死了。

sentences.en: Beck said Watts dumped the red doona and its contents at the Lowood rubbish tip and watched it burn.
sentences.zh: 贝克说沃茨把红色的羽绒被连同里面的东西扔到了洛伍德垃圾填埋场，并看着它燃烧。

sentences.en: Based on further information provided by Beck, police believed Helen's remains may have been relocated and buried at a different location,
sentences.zh: 根据贝克提供的进一步信息，警方认为海伦的遗骸可能被转移并埋葬在另一个地方，

sentences.en: somewhere between Lowood and Wivenhoe Dam.
sentences.zh: 位于洛伍德和维文霍水坝之间的某个地方。

sentences.en: The subsequent searches of these areas resulted in no discoveries.
sentences.zh: 随后对这些区域的搜查没有任何发现。

sentences.en: Barry Watts was put on trial for Helen Feeney's murder in 1995.
sentences.zh: 巴里·沃茨于1995年因谋杀海伦·费尼而受审。

sentences.en: but no evidence could be found to corroborate Valmaybeck's assertions that her former husband was responsible for the crime.
sentences.zh: 但找不到任何证据来证实瓦尔迈·贝克的断言，即她的前夫对这起罪行负责。

sentences.en: Barry Watts continued to deny any involvement in Helen's disappearance, and the inmates Watts allegedly confessed to were uncooperative in court.
sentences.zh: 巴里·沃茨继续否认自己参与了海伦的失踪，而沃茨据称向其坦白的犯人在法庭上不予配合。

sentences.en: Information gathered by the undercover police officer who shared a cell with Watts was not permitted into evidence.
sentences.zh: 与沃茨同监的卧底警员收集的信息未被允许作为证据采纳。

sentences.en: That officer suffered a nervous breakdown and resigned from the police force, attributing his collapse partly to the horror of working on the case.
sentences.zh: 那名警员精神崩溃并辞去了警察职务，他将自己的崩溃部分归咎于参与该案的恐怖经历。

sentences.en: The lack of compelling evidence or a body, coupled with unreliable testimony from Valmay Beck, resulted in Barry Watts being acquitted of Helen May Feeney's murder.
sentences.zh: 缺乏令人信服的证据或尸体，再加上瓦尔迈·贝克不可靠的证词，导致巴里·沃茨被判谋杀海伦·玛丽·费尼罪名不成立。

sentences.en: Her case remains unsolved to this day.
sentences.zh: 她的案件至今仍未侦破。

sentences.en: In 1993, Valmay Beck fell in love with notorious serial rapist Robert John Farden after meeting him at an annual prison barbecue put on for lifers.
sentences.zh: 1993年，瓦尔迈·贝克在终身犯年度监狱烧烤晚会上结识了臭名昭著的连环强奸犯罗伯特·约翰·法登，并与他坠入爱河。

sentences.en: Their relationship lasted several years and by 1998 Farden wanted to become Beck's fourth husband, going so far as asking a
sentences.zh: 他们的关系持续了好几年，到1998年，法登想成为贝克的第四任丈夫，甚至请求

sentences.en: pastor if he could purchase an engagement ring through mail order.
sentences.zh: 牧师是否可以通过邮购购买一枚订婚戒指。

sentences.en: The couple were denied the opportunity to marry and Farden was relocated to a different prison.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇结婚的请求被拒绝，法登被转移到了另一座监狱。

sentences.en: Their relationship appeared to have stopped there.
sentences.zh: 他们的关系似乎就此终止了。

sentences.en: Valmay Beck later converted to Christianity, and cold case detectives periodically interviewed her about Helen Feeney and other unsolved cases, in the hopes that the
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈·贝克后来皈依了基督教，积案侦探定期就海伦·费尼和其他未破案件对她进行讯问，希望这位

sentences.en: convicted killer's newfound religious beliefs would compel her to confess to other crimes.
sentences.zh: 被定罪的杀人犯新获得的宗教信仰能迫使她承认其他罪行。

sentences.en: However, Beck offered no information.
sentences.zh: 然而，贝克没有提供任何信息。

sentences.en: In 2003, Beck was in the newspapers again, this time for befriending controversial politician Pauline Hanson, who was serving time for electoral fraud.
sentences.zh: 2003年，贝克再次登上报纸头条，这次是因为她与因选举欺诈而在狱中服刑的争议性政治人物波琳·汉森交朋友。

sentences.en: After her release, Pauline Hanson told Woman's Day magazine that she felt sorry for Beck and the two had become close in prison after they, quote, had a laugh and hit it off.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，波琳·汉森告诉《女性周刊》杂志，她为贝克感到难过，两人在监狱里经由，引用原话，开怀大笑并一拍即合后变得亲密起来。

sentences.en: Hanson described Beck as a very nice lady who she was glad to have met, adding that the convicted child rapist and killer had provided assistance,
sentences.zh: 汉森将贝克描述为一个非常好的女士，很高兴能认识她，并补充说这位被定罪的儿童强奸犯和杀人犯曾在汉森需要的时候给予了协助，

sentences.en: help, and friendship when Hansen needed it.
sentences.zh: 帮助和友谊。

sentences.en: The politician's remarks fuelled public backlash and elicited a response from Sian Kingy's family, who had up until that point avoided
sentences.zh: 这位政治人物的言论引发了公众的强烈反感，并招致了西恩·金吉家人的回应，他们在此之前一直避免

sentences.en: speaking publicly about their daughter's murder.
sentences.zh: 公开谈论他们女儿的谋杀案。

sentences.en: A spokesperson for the Kingy family called Pauline
sentences.zh: 金吉一家的发言人称波琳

sentences.en: Hansen naive and condemned the politician's lack of clear judgement.
sentences.zh: 汉森天真，并谴责这位政治人物缺乏清晰的判断力。

sentences.en: After serving almost 20 years of her life sentence, Valmay Beck tried several times to get parole, but her request was denied each time.
sentences.zh: 在服了近20年无期徒刑后，瓦尔迈·贝克曾多次试图获得假释，但她的请求每次都被拒绝。

sentences.en: In May 2007, she told Townsville Correctional Centre staff she had significant information in relation to the disappearance of Helen Feeney, but subsequent questioning proved
sentences.zh: 2007年5月，她告诉汤斯维尔矫正中心的工作人员，她有关于海伦·费尼失踪的重要信息，但随后的讯问证明

sentences.en: fruitless and led to no breakthroughs in the case.
sentences.zh: 毫无结果，并未给案件带来任何突破。

sentences.en: By 2008, Valmay Beck had a number of severe health probleMs. After being hospitalised for minor heart surgery in May that year,
sentences.zh: 到2008年，瓦尔迈·贝克有许多严重的健康问题。当年5月因接受小型心脏手术住院后，

sentences.en: Beck's condition deteriorated and she was put into an induced coma.
sentences.zh: 贝克的病情恶化，并被置于药物诱导昏迷状态。

sentences.en: Detectives remained convinced that Beck knew more about other crimes than she ever admitted and held out hopes for a deathbed confession.
sentences.zh: 侦探们依然坚信贝克对其他罪行的了解比她承认的要多，并寄希望于临终忏悔。

sentences.en: There was heated debate about whether Beck, who had expressed the desire not to be resuscitated, should be kept alive for that reason.
sentences.zh: 关于是否应该出于这个原因让表达了不愿被心肺复苏意愿的贝克继续维持生命，引发了激烈的争论。

sentences.en: On May 27, 2008, 64-year-old Valmay Beck died in custody at Townsville Hospital from complications arising from heart surgery.
sentences.zh: 2008年5月27日，64岁的瓦尔迈·贝克在汤斯维尔医院因心脏手术引起的并发症在拘押中死亡。

sentences.en: Investigators never got their deathbed confession.
sentences.zh: 调查人员最终也没能得到他们期望的临终忏悔。

sentences.en: Any secrets Beck may have had died with her.
sentences.zh: 贝克可能掌握的任何秘密都随着她的死而烟消云散。

sentences.en: Noosa Detective Sergeant Bob Atkinson, who had previously led the investigation into Sean Kingy's disappearance and murder, was later promoted to police commissioner.
sentences.zh: 曾领导肖恩·金吉失踪和谋杀案调查的努萨侦探警长鲍勃·阿特金森后来被晋升为警务专员。

sentences.en: Atkinson said he was positive Sian Kingy was not the only victim of Barry Watts and the late
sentences.zh: 阿特金森表示，他确信西恩·金吉不是巴里·沃茨和已故的

sentences.en: Valmay Beck, telling reporters, quote,
sentences.zh: 瓦尔迈·贝克的唯一受害者，他告诉记者，引用原话，

sentences.en: Atkinson never forgot the case of Sian Kingy.
sentences.zh: 阿特金森从未忘记西恩·金吉的案件。

sentences.en: Memories of the 1987 case flooded back in 2003 when the Sunshine Coast was shaken by the unexplained disappearance of 13-year-old Daniel Morecambe.
sentences.zh: 2003年，当阳光海岸因13岁丹尼尔·莫卡姆的不明失踪而震惊时，1987年案件的记忆如潮水般涌回。

sentences.en: Just like he had done for the Kingey family,
sentences.zh: 就像他为金吉一家所做的那样，

sentences.en: Atkinson promised the Morecams he would never let the police service give up on finding their child.
sentences.zh: 阿特金森向莫卡姆一家承诺，他绝不会让警务部门放弃寻找他们的孩子。

sentences.en: The disappearance of Daniel Morecambe is covered in case 54 of Casefile.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·莫卡姆的失踪案收录在《案件档案》第54案中。

sentences.en: In 2009, 53-year-old Barry Watts sought parole, but he could only be considered if he took responsibility and expressed remorse for his crimes.
sentences.zh: 2009年，53岁的巴里·沃茨申请假释，但他只有在承担责任并对自己的罪行表示悔意的情况下才会被考虑。

sentences.en: This led to Watts finally breaking his 20-year silence about the murder of Sean Kingy.
sentences.zh: 这促使沃茨终于打破了关于谋杀肖恩·金吉长达20年的沉默。

sentences.en: In an interview described by detectives as chilling, Watts made a full confession.
sentences.zh: 在一次被侦探们形容为令人毛骨悚然的采访中，沃茨进行了全面坦白。

sentences.en: His parole application was denied.
sentences.zh: 他的假释申请被拒绝了。

sentences.en: Barry Watts remains in prison today.
sentences.zh: 巴里·沃茨至今仍被关在监狱里。

sentences.en: He has shown zero remorse for the murder of Sean Kingy and has never confessed to any other crimes.
sentences.zh: 他对谋杀肖恩·金吉表现出零悔意，并且从未承认过任何其他罪行。

sentences.en: Those involved with the case have vowed to do everything in their power to ensure that Watts will never be released.
sentences.zh: 涉案人员发誓要尽一切力量确保沃茨永远不会被释放。

sentences.en: Former Sunshine Coast detective Alan Burke worked on many horrendous crimes over the years, but nothing made quite the same emotional impact as the Sean Kingy case.
sentences.zh: 前阳光海岸侦探阿兰·伯克多年来处理过许多骇人听闻的罪行，但没有什么能像肖恩·金吉案那样带来如此巨大的情感冲击。

sentences.en: Quote, anyone that was directly involved in that homicide was never the same again.
sentences.zh: 引用原话，任何直接参与该起凶杀案的人都再也回不到从前了。

sentences.en: It was horrific.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: Through that initial period, we found out Sian had a loving family.
sentences.zh: 在那段最初的时期，我们发现西恩有一个充满爱的家庭。

sentences.en: She was a lovely girl with a future in front of her.
sentences.zh: 她是个可爱的女孩，有着大好的前途。

sentences.en: We were hoping she'd turn up, and to see her murdered was absolutely shattering.
sentences.zh: 我们一直希望她能出现，看到她被谋杀简直令人心碎。

sentences.en: Sian was a passionate netball player and loved hitting the courts with her team on the weekends.
sentences.zh: 西恩是一名充满激情的无挡板篮球运动员，周末很喜欢和她的团队一起在球场上挥洒汗水。

sentences.en: Her tall, slim frame towered over many of her smaller peers, making her quite the intimidating competitor.
sentences.zh: 她高挑苗条的身材在许多较矮的同伴中显得格外高大，使她成为了一个颇具威慑力的竞争对手。

sentences.en: During the heat of a contest, Sian would sometimes accidentally knock other opponents over.
sentences.zh: 在激烈的比赛中，西恩有时会不小心把其他对手撞倒。

sentences.en: When this happened, she would immediately stop playing mid-game to pick them up, give them a friendly brush down, and ask kindly, are you alright?
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，她会立刻在比赛进行到一半时停下来扶起她们，友好地拍拍她们身上的灰尘，亲切地问一句，你还好吗？

sentences.en: The Kingy family have never spoken publicly about Sian's murder.
sentences.zh: 金吉一家从未公开谈论过西恩的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Their focus has always remained on celebrating Sian's life, remembering her as their smiling, free-spirited daughter, who loved parties, riding her bike, netball, jazz ballet,
sentences.zh: 他们的重心始终放在庆祝西恩的生命上，铭记她是一个爱笑、崇尚自由的女儿，她喜欢派对、骑自行车、无挡板篮球、爵士芭蕾，

sentences.en: and who would always stop whatever she was doing to pick others up, when they needed it.
sentences.zh: 并且每当别人需要时，她总是会放下手头正在做的一切去扶别人一把。
